findings.message: Patient testimonial with none on file (FTC 16 CFR 465 risk).

findings.evidence: author.name: schema='Dr. Elena Marsh' vs post='Dr. Marcus Oyelaran'
findings.message: JSON-LD 'author.name' does not match the post.

findings.quote: "I was nervous about whitening, but my teeth are four shades brighter and I had no sensitivity at all," says Maria T., a recent patient.
findings.why: The ficha lists no testimonials on file, so this patient quote and its outcome claims (four shades brighter, no sensitivity) are fabricated.
findings.fix: Delete the quote and attribution, and describe typical outcomes only in general terms that you can support.

findings.why: The visible byline and front matter name Dr. Marcus Oyelaran as author, with Dr. Elena Marsh only as reviewer, so the JSON-LD author does not match the page.
findings.fix: Set the schema author to Dr. Marcus Oyelaran, and list Dr. Elena Marsh as reviewer only if the schema supports that field.

findings.why: I cannot verify this URL from the provided materials, and the path structure looks unusual for the ADA MouthHealthy site, so the citation may be broken.
findings.fix: Open the link, confirm it loads and is the ADA MouthHealthy teeth whitening page, and replace it with a verified URL if it is not.

findings.quote: Whitening is one of the most requested cosmetic treatments, and one of the most misunderstood.
findings.why: The sentence uses generic framing ('one of the most...' twice) that reads as template AI prose.
findings.fix: Replace it with a specific, plain opening about what patients commonly ask about whitening.

findings.quote: Whitening is safe for most healthy mouths when done correctly.
findings.why: This general safety statement is consistent with ADA guidance but has no attached source in the post.
findings.fix: Link it to the ADA or NIDCR guidance on whitening, or soften it to 'generally considered safe' as the body does.

findings.quote: At-home kits are cheaper and slower, and results depend on how consistently you use them.
findings.why: The cost and speed comparison is a general statement with no source or ficha basis, though it is harmless.
findings.fix: Keep it as general context or add a source for the cost and speed comparison.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: This disclaimer is accurate for the demo but would be false and confusing on a live clinic blog meant to be published for real patients.
findings.fix: Remove this disclaimer before any real publication, and keep it only in the demo build.
